sourceTitle: The Deaf Shoemaker: To Which Are Added Other Stories for the Young
description: "The Deaf Shoemaker: To Which Are Added Other Stories for the Young" by Philip Barrett is a collection of moral tales and inspirational stories written in the mid-19th century. This compilation centers on themes of perseverance, faith, and character development, particularly aimed at a young audience.
